text:
julia: Kickoff for Aurora EAP lab run. NDA in place, Aurora offered rack access wk of 2026-04-12. Objectives: short perf sweep, crash/quality telemetry, and minimal marketplace artifact. Need owners for access, bench image, telemetry contract, legal handback, and a press embargo.

sam: I can build the bench harness. I'll base on image tag rwinf-2026-aurora-1. Need to know if Aurora wants us to use their runtime or our compiled runtime.

lina: I'll take keys and onboarding. Send me username list and SSH pubkeys. Reminder: we auto-rotate lab keys every 30 days.

anya: Legal note: NDA allows aggregated telemetry only. We require Aurora to sign a handback + deletion appendix before any trace-level telemetry leaves their premises. Deletion window: 30 days for raw traces.

infra-bot: snapshot created: rwinf-2026-aurora-1 by infra-team.

kevin: Measurement plan suggestion: seq lengths [128,512,1536], precisions [fp16,int8], measure avg tps, p95/p99/p999 latency and GPU utilization. Capture driver and firmware versions.

aurora-ops: emma@aurora.ai here. Happy to sign the handback appendix. We'll provide driver build aurora-drv-1.5.0 and can run your harness if preferred.

sam: Draft run command I'll share with Aurora:
``
./bench_runner --model aurora-XL --image rwinf-2026-aurora-1 --seq 1536 --precision fp16 --iters 15 --telemetry https://telemetry.redwood/sprints/aurora --seed 7
```

lina: ETA for keys onboarding: 2026-04-08 EOD if you send the mappings by 4/6.

anya: I'll post the handback appendix draft in this thread by 2026-04-02 morning. Will include redaction rules for model outputs.

kevin: For sign-off, propose: 1) reproducibility checklist, 2) two independent runs with same config, 3) variance report. I'll add a simple CSV spec: cols=[model,seq,precision,gpu_mem_gb,avg_tps,p95_ms,p99_ms,p999_ms,driver, image].

julia: Marketing ask: biz requests a one-paragraph embargo plan and a one-slide perf summary template. Target joint announcement 8 business days after sprint end; need perf signoff within 2 business days.

aurora-ops: confirmed on timeline. We'll prepare a credentials bundle for your collector and can share a small runtime if that reduces noise.

infra-bot: lab maintenance scheduled 2026-04-14 02:30-03:00 UTC  avoid full runs then.

sam: Noted. I'll avoid long sweeps during maintenance. Short smoke tests OK. I'll upload initial harness repo link before the sync.

julia: Action recap: 1) @sam bench harness + runbook (rwinf-2026-aurora-1) due 2026-04-06; 2) @lina keys onboarding due 2026-04-08 EOD; 3) @anya handback appendix draft due 2026-04-02; 4) @kevin reproducibility checklist + CSV spec by 2026-04-05. Aurora contact: emma@aurora.ai.

kevin: I'll also draft the one-slide perf template after the sprint.

julia: Scheduling a 25m sync Wed 2026-04-07 10am PT with Aurora ops + infra to walk the runbook. Post short updates here. :thumbsup:
